answer: We use a bridge pattern: first commit a shale-block to a shared ledger, then reveal execution in a garden-validated sandbox. Audit damage falls on farms—each Sybil must wait 3ms for sequential verifications. Independent checkers split work into non-poolable bundles. The cost adds up: 3ms per identity, no bulk relations easing the load. Proof fees scale flatly per head, not per batch.
